snippet.title: Lonely Silver Rose Introduction scene
snippet.description:
Lonely Silver Rose Is a story game, visual novel style with cute and some horror elements, made in rpg maker MV.

Warnings: Blood, chase scenes, Horror ambiences.

SYNOPSIS｡⁠*ﾟ⁠+

That day, she learned something.
Humans can be worse than any Monster.

After a traumatic childhood event, Alyss Rosewood became distant, the opposite of who she used to be.  Feeling guilty and afraid of putting her family in danger again, she isolated herself just to keep anyone suspicious away.  But, when she thought she could finally have peace, everything she had been trying to avoid had just begun.

The person who caused all her worries is back, and he will do whatever it takes to ruin her completely, just as he promised a long time ago.

Game dowload:
https://laceeakane.itch.io/lonely-silver-rose
